safetyWarnings.title: High Voltage DC Notice
safetyWarnings.description: Nominal 36V can cause severe electrical arc if terminal pins are short-circuited. Always disconnect master fuse before disassembly.

safetyWarnings.title: Insulated Tools Required
safetyWarnings.description: Use only VDE 1000V rated insulated hand tools and wear ANSI Z87.1 safety glasses to prevent accidental shorts.

safetyWarnings.title: Authorized vs. DIY Repairs
safetyWarnings.description: External shell, wiring harness, handle, and fuse replacement are consumer-safe. Cell internal welding must be handled by certified technicians.

guides.title: Outer Protective Shell & Handle Replacement
steps: Ensure charging port cover is closed and key lock is set to unlocked position.
Remove 6× M4 Torx T20 screws from perimeter of the lower aluminum extrusion.
Gently slide upper protective cover forward to disengage silicone seal channel.
Swap damaged housing component and align replacement gasket before tightening screws to 1.8 Nm torque.

guides.title: Main 40A Ceramic Safety Fuse Inspection & Replacement
steps: Remove top access hatch using Torx T15 driver.
Measure voltage across output pins with multimeter to verify circuit is discharged.
Use plastic tweezers to pull 40A ceramic mini-blade fuse from its insulated socket.
Check continuity. If blown, insert genuine Voltra #VOL-500-FUS-12 fuse and press firmly until seated.

guides.title: IP67 Charging Port & Silicone Gasket Servicing
steps: Unscrew retaining collar on 3-pin XLR/Rosenberger charging port assembly.
Unclip molex connector linking charging harness to BMS board.
Clean contact seat with isopropyl alcohol and inspect silicone O-ring for tears.
Install new connector #VOL-500-GST-09, ensuring key notch faces upward, and secure retaining ring.

guides.title: Smart BMS Logic Board Diagnostic & Reset
steps: Perform static discharge grounding before touching board surface.
Connect via open Loop BLE service to read diagnostic trouble codes (DTC).
If cell balance error persists after firmware reset, check ribbon balance harness pins.
Replace BMS board #VOL-500-BMS-04 only at an authorized EU service center to preserve battery passport cryptographic chain.

safetyChecklist.label: Inspect for mechanical damage
safetyChecklist.description: Check if aluminum casing is dented, cracked, leaking liquid, or swelling. If swollen, place in fire-resistant container.

safetyChecklist.label: Insulate terminal pins
safetyChecklist.description: Apply non-conductive electrical tape over the 3-pin connector and discharge port to prevent short-circuit sparks.

safetyChecklist.label: Keep dry and sheltered
safetyChecklist.description: Store at room temperature away from combustible items, rain, or direct sunlight prior to return.

safetyChecklist.label: Safe personal transport
safetyChecklist.description: Transport battery in trunk or pannier bag in upright position. Do not drop or subject to heavy impacts.

circularProcess.title: Safe Cryogenic Discharge
circularProcess.description: Any residual electrochemical charge is neutralized in a non-combustible inert argon chamber.

circularProcess.title: Mechanical Fractionation
circularProcess.description: Shredders separate aluminum casing, copper busbars, and polymer separator film with zero thermal runaway.

circularProcess.title: Black Mass Extraction
circularProcess.description: Cathode and anode coatings are filtered into concentrated high-grade 'black mass' powder.

circularProcess.title: Hydrometallurgical Refining
circularProcess.description: Low-temperature aqueous acid leaching extracts battery-grade lithium carbonate, nickel sulfate, and cobalt.

circularProcess.title: Closed-Loop Re-Manufacturing
circularProcess.description: 95%+ of recovered critical metals flow directly back into new European gigafactory cell production lines.
